=== git credentials ===
http.version HTTP/1.1

observation.command: echo "=== gh CLI? ==="; which gh && gh auth status 2>&1 | head; echo "=== tokens in common locations ==="; env | grep -iE "token|key|secret|gh_|github" ; echo "---"; cat ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls ~/.gradle/gradle.properties 2>/dev/null && cat ~/.gradle/gradle.properties 2>/dev/null; echo "=== git credentials ==="; git config --get-regexp "credential|http" 2>/dev/null
